The About Me Handoff Checklist

What to ask your wife, write down and hand to her new caregivers.

Download PDF

New caregivers start this week. They'll have your wife's chart. The tea before anything else, the radio in the kitchen, the name she likes to be called: those are still with you. Check what you've done. Anything unchecked is simply still to do.

Ask

Write

Share

What this checklist doesn't do

It helps you ask, write down and hand over. It doesn't say what any of her preferences should mean for her care, turn a like or dislike into an instruction, or fill in what she hasn't said. Those belong to her and to the people who assess her, and to the next step below.

Ready for the next step?

You've asked her, written it down and found out who receives it. The care interview takes the same care with the rest of her situation: it walks you through her preferences alongside her care needs and the people who support her, area by area, and turns your answers into a Family Care Profile you can bring to any care conversation.

Where this comes from

The items marked 1 follow questions in The Conversation Project's What Matters to Me workbook; the rest come from the Family Care Roadmap's own working list for this step.
